I am very good with dogs, especially "bully breeds". I can sense agitation, fear, etc. in how they stand/act, etc. And I still have been bitten by this dog. And he is a sweetheart.

Things to think about:

1) Training is everything. You must be willing to put in the time. This is not a Golden or Lab.

2) With great power comes great responsibility. These dogs are bred to be dangerous. Only your control stops them from doing so. Make sure you are ready for this responsibility.

3) They are cuddle dogs. They will want to sit on the sofa next to you, get under blankets, etc. They are great dogs, but are NOT super family dogs. Kids that "don't get it" may get a snap or a nip of a bite, possibly worse.

4) They were bred for protection and hunting, not for protection. So they will hunt and protect. Just be aware.

edit : formatting is hard

They bond very closely with their owners and will have major anxiety issues if you're not around (or even if you're around and ignoring them). They also whine continuously (any dobie owner who claims otherwise is both used to tuning it out and lying). They're also quite intelligent, very trainable, and REQUIRE extensive training. This isnt some braindead lab where if you train it to come on command and poop outside you're golden. this is near-service dog levels of training. You also need to keep in mind that they are both a large and "aggressive" breed, which means it's nigh impossible to rent an apartment with one even if it's so well trained it wouldnt hurt a fly. So you need to own a house. Their patience is also notably less than more common large breeds, which makes them ill-suited for children. E.g. a golden or a lab is just going to ignore or run away from obnoxious children. A dobie is going to lay their exhibiting subtle "I'm going to tear your face off" body language if someone keeps harassing it. Adults will pick up on that and back off. Kids, not so much. It also outweighs kids and has large teeth, so not a good pet for kids.

TLDR: Good, smart dog for adults with a house who want to spend an inordinate amount of time training it. Bad dog for kids, apartments, or people who dont want to spend inordinate amounts of time training it.
